title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：tone　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tone 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the postman ① set the tone that no sender in the office would have counted, and he said the setting was the whole of the week. The ② tone, meaning the sound itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed uncounted in the book; a tone, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ tone in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ tone at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tone, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the postman said the counting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tone was the whole of the matter, meaning the attitude and not the sound. The ⑥ tone, meaning the attitude and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; tone, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both a sound and an attitude. He said the attitude is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ tone had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ tone of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of counting; tone, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tone I remember is the sound counted in the list, which closed in 1961 and is still counted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ tone, my mother said in 1963, is the only sound that improves by being counted; every tone, she said, is an attitude that has agreed to look like a sound. She said the attitude was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 语气；音调（指邮局里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 语气；音调（指那种语气本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：set the tone 定这一种语气
D. n. 语气；音调（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 语气之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的语气之事）
F. n. 语气；音调（指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 语气、态度（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 态度（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: set the tone that no sender in the office would have counted
The tone, meaning the sound itself and not the envelope
the tone at the far box
the tone was the whole of the matter
the tone had become a line in a list
The tone of the whole thing
A tone, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: set the tone 意为“定这一种语气”，1954 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯清点的一种语气做了一遍。
tone 意为“语气；音调”，指那种语气本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被清点。
tone 意为“语气；音调”，指邮局里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
tone 意为“语气；音调”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tone 意为“语气、态度”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种态度就是那件事的全部。
tone 意为“态度”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种语气，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tone 意为“语气；音调”，指收发清单里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1959 年这一种成了收发清单里的一行。
tone 意为“语气之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的语气之事是一处邮局和三个星期的清点。
tone 意为“语气；音调”，我记得的是收发清单里清点过的那一种，1961 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一种。
tone 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，语气是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的语气。
